remarks: With spectacular mountain and ocean views, this gorgeous home is nestled in the Palisades Highlands neighborhood on one of its most coveted streets. A true retreat offering peace and privacy, it's just minutes from the Palisades' best dining and shopping. On a beautifully landscaped 0.40-acre lot, this 5-bedroom, 5.5-bath residence offers 4,875 sq ft and a floor plan made for everyday living, entertaining and effortless indoor-outdoor flow. Walls of windows fill the home with light, and French doors open to the gardens, fountains, balconies and expansive views. The gourmet chef's kitchen features a Wolf oven and cooktop, a Sub-Zero refrigerator and two Miele dishwashers. Brand-new white oak
